summary: Curated Yang-Mills unblock dossier summarizing eleven raw idea files into graph candidates, bridge cards, quarantines, discards, PNG handling notes and a verification queue. The raw files are not copied into the repository; candidate graph objects remain staged because the machine-readable bundle contains source-note references, empty URLs and non-canonical relation names.

promoted.title: Yang-Mills unblock triage dossier
promoted.rationale: The dossier sorts thirty-seven ideas into promote, quarantine, discard, superseded and verification categories while preserving a no-claim boundary around hRpoly and Clay.

promoted.title: Gaussian collar factorization-defect ladder
promoted.rationale: A staged G0-to-G3 path could produce a concrete volume-uniform collar defect estimate for the Yang-Mills activity producer, but it must fail early if G0 is not uniform.

promoted.title: Schur-Catalan multiscale closure template
promoted.rationale: The abstract Catalan-budget closure is a useful template for coercivity-minus-self-energy arguments, but each physical or arithmetic instance must separately prove positivity and the Catalan expansion.

promoted.title: P4 activity contract and quantifier discipline
promoted.rationale: The contract records that the real gauge activity must be defined before the decay estimate is proved, and rejects wrappers that store the desired estimate as a hypothesis.

promoted.title: Rooted closure of order, geometry and scale sums
promoted.rationale: Under explicit carried hypotheses, Tonelli and a geometric-series bound collapse three convergence budgets into one rooted observable; it is bookkeeping, not a source estimate.

promoted.title: Resolvent compactification and finite moment certificates
promoted.rationale: The Penrose-Stieltjes and Hausdorff-certificate ideas are useful as shared finite spectral-method candidates, but require source checks before any novelty or literature promotion.

promoted.title: Blow-up of joint limit corners
promoted.rationale: Replacing a degenerate joint limit by its approach direction may preserve physical scaling data that sequential limits erase.

promoted.title: Primary-source verification queue
promoted.rationale: The queue identifies source checks that must be resolved before any staged candidate can be promoted to literature or formal graph status.

quarantined.title: Everettian and teleportation recovery proposals
quarantined.rationale: The branch-register, Bell/CHSH and teleportation material is interpretive or qualitative and does not provide uniform constants for hRpoly.

quarantined.title: RG proper time and Janus complexity analogies
quarantined.rationale: These analogies are retained only if they produce a concrete reparameterization-invariant bound or monotone in a later cycle.

discarded.reason: The source itself treats the Kabbalah selector as mnemonic, not as a mathematical dimension derivation.
examples: 4/5/10/22/32 worlds and paths as a selector for four dimensions

discarded.reason: The source gives a decoupled stacked-layers counterexample; dynamics, not embedding in a fifth dimension, supplies interconnection.
examples: 3D sheets stacked in a fifth dimension

discarded.reason: The source explicitly rejects RH implies Yang-Mills and Yang-Mills implies RH; only a shared abstract library is allowed.
Mathematical_Saffolding.txt is recorded as a zero-byte empty file and carries no extractable claim.
